[[Eurocup Basketball|Eurocup]] | team = Baloncesto Sevilla | number = 6 | position = [[Power forward (basketball)|Power forward]] / [[Center (basketball)|Center]] | birth_date = {{Birth date and age|1995|08|02}} | birth_place = [[Liepāja]], [[Latvia]] | nationality = Latvian | highschool = | college = | draft_year = | draft_round = | draft_pick = | draft_team = | career_start = 2012 | career_end = | years1 = 2011–present | team1 = [[CB Sevilla|Baloncesto Sevilla]] | years2 = 2011–2012 | team2 = → Sevilla B | highlights = * [[Eurocup Basketball Awards#Eurocup Rising Star|Eurocup Rising Star]] ([[2014–15 Eurocup Basketball|2015]]) * 2x [[ACB Best Young Player Award|ACB All-Young Players Team]] ([[2013–14 ACB season|2014]]–[[2014–15 ACB season|2015]]) | medaltemplates = }} '''Kristaps Porziņģis''' ({{IPA-lv|'kris.taps 'pʊ͡ɔr.ziɲ.ɟis}}; born August 2, 1995) is a Latvian professional [[basketball]] player who plays for [[CB Sevilla|Baloncesto Sevilla]] of the [[Liga ACB]]. Standing {{height|ft=7|in=1}} and weighing {{convert|231|lbs|kg}}, he plays the [[Power forward (basketball)|power forward]] and [[Center (basketball)|center]] positions. While being brought up in [[Liepāja]], [[Latvia]] Porziņģis started out his career with youth teams in his hometown before trying out and making the [[CB Sevilla|Baloncesto Sevilla]] youth squads. Following multiple years with the junior teams of Sevilla and representing them in [[Euroleague Basketball Next Generation Tournament|Nike International Junior Tournaments]], he was promoted to the senior squad and has been known as one of the top international prospects for the [[2015 NBA draft]] ever since. Porziņģis competed with the [[Latvia national basketball team|Latvia youth national team]] at the [[2013 FIBA Europe Under-18 Championship]]. ==Early career== Porziņģis followed his parents' footsteps and started to play [[basketball]] at age 6. He played in youth competition with [[BK Liepājas Lauvas]], the most famous club based in hometown of [[Liepāja]], until he was 15 years old. An agent from Latvia sent video of him around this time to teams in [[Spain]] and [[Italy]].In 2010, [[CB Sevilla|Baloncesto Sevilla]], a club that had a professional team competing in the [[Liga ACB]] in Spain, called Porziņģis for a tryout in an attempt to recruit foreign talent to its junior squads. He stood 6 ft 8 in (2.03 m) and weighed 157 lbs (71 kg) at this time.{{cite web|url=http://www.eurocupbasketball.com/eurocup/features/player-spotlight/i/141583|title=Kristaps Porzingis, Baloncesto Seville |publisher=Eurocupbasketball.com|accessdate=April 14, 2015}}{{cite web|title=Kristaps Porzingis|url=http://www.draftexpress.com/profile/Kristaps-Porzingis-7119/|website=''Draft Express''|accessdate=20 June 2015}} Porziņģis recalled the moment and said, "I came here with my brother for two or three days, but it was really hot and I couldn't play at my best because of that. Still, I received a contract in summer 2010 and I signed it." Inmaculada Avivar, a nutritionist for Sevilla, diagnosed that Porziņģis was suffering from [[anemia]], meaning that he had fewer [[red blood cell]]s.{{cite web|title=Anemia|url=http://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/anemia|website=http://www.merriam-webster.com/|accessdate=7 July 2014}} This caused him to feel fatigue, shortness of breath, and inability to exercise. Nevertheless, he gradually overcame the condition and began seeing improvement in his game. In addition to his medical problems, Porziņģis had trouble picking up the [[Spanish language|language]] in [[Seville]], making him reluctant to return there after his first tryout. In his first season playing for the junior squad, he struggled to communicate with the coaching staff and his teammates and was often sleepy due to his health. Porziņģis debuted for the youth squad on January 4, 2012 against its counterpart from [[FC Barcelona Bàsquet|Barcelona]], adding 12 points and 10 rebounds. The opposing side was led by Alexandr Zhigulin, who would go on to enter the [[2015 NBA draft]] and withdraw.{{cite web|title=Alexandr Zhigulin Player Profile|url=http://basketball.realgm.com/player/Alexandr-Zhigulin/Summary/25104|website=''[[RealGM]]''|accessdate=20 June 2015}} However, Sevilla was heavily defeated, 56-75.{{cite web|title=FC Barcelona Regal Junior Team 75, Cajasol Seville Junior Team 56|url=http://basketball.realgm.com/international/boxscore/2012-01-04/FC-Barcelona-Regal-Junior-Team-at-Cajasol-Seville-Junior-Team/87361|website=''[[RealGM]]''|accessdate=20 June 2015}} This game was part of the Ciutat de L'Hospitalet tournament, which led up to the [[Euroleague Basketball Next Generation Tournament|Nike International Junior Tournament]] (NIJT). On January 5, he scored a personal best of 16 points on the [[OKK Spars Sarajevo|Spars Sarajevo]] youth squad, helping Sevilla beat their opponents by a margin of 8 points.{{cite web|title=Cajasol Seville Junior Team 80, KK Spars Junior Team 72|url=http://basketball.realgm.com/international/boxscore/2012-01-05/Cajasol-Seville-Junior-Team-at-KK-Spars-Junior-Team/87369|website=''[[RealGM]]''|accessdate=20 June 2015}} Porziņģis said, "I knew it was a prestigious tournament and that I had to do well," he said. "I think I could have done much better, but I wasn't physically 100 percent. I have seen videos and could have been much more aggressive. But I wish I could have played better." He finished the tournament averaging 9.2 points, 4.8 rebounds and 2.6 blocks. Porziņģis represented the Sevilla junior team again at the same tournament in early 2013. Against [[KK Olimpija|Union Olimpija]] on January 4, he recorded 15 points and 6 rebounds.{{cite web|title=Union Olimpija Junior Team 70, Cajasol Seville Junior Team 78|url=http://basketball.realgm.com/international/boxscore/2013-01-04/Union-Olimpija-Junior-Team-at-Cajasol-Seville-Junior-Team/120276|website=''[[RealGM]]''|accessdate=20 June 2015}} On January 6, in the team's tournament finale vs [[Real Madrid Baloncesto B|Real Madrid]]'s youth squad, he scored 24 points and grabbed 11 rebounds. He also made a total of five three-pointers.{{cite web|title=Cajasol Seville Junior Team 66, Real Madrid Junior Team 72|url=http://basketball.realgm.com/international/boxscore/2013-01-06/Cajasol-Seville-Junior-Team-at-Real-Madrid-Junior-Team/120286|website=''[[RealGM]]''|accessdate=20 June 2015}} Porziņģis proved to be more effective in his second year, averaging 16.6 points, 8.4 rebounds and 2.6 blocks and going .481 on three-pointers. This would be his final stint in the youth categories of Sevilla. == Professional career == === Cajasol Sevilla (2012–present) === Entering the [[2012–13 ACB season]], Cajasol Sevilla had hired [[Aíto García Reneses]], who previously worked with the likes of [[Pau Gasol]], [[Juan Carlos Navarro (basketball)|Juan Carlos Navarro]], [[Ricky Rubio]], and [[Rudy Fernández (basketball)|Rudy Fernández]]. On September 29, 2012, Porziņģis got the opportunity to make an appearance with the club's first team, but was allowed to play just a minute. Sevilla took a tremendous loss to [[CB Murcia]].{{cite web|title=Universidad Catolica De Murcia CB 93, Baloncesto Sevilla 77|url=http://basketball.realgm.com/international/boxscore/2012-09-29/Universidad-Catolica-De-Murcia-CB-at-Baloncesto-Sevilla/103535|website=''[[RealGM]]''|accessdate=20 June 2015}} Following a return to the youth categories of the club at the Torneig de Bàsquet Junior Ciutat de L'Hospitalet, he went back to competing for the senior squad. On January 16, 2013, he logged only four minutes against [[BC Spartak Saint Petersburg]] in the [[Eurocup Basketball|Eurocup]], scoring no points, but contributing one rebound and one assist.{{cite web|title=Baloncesto Sevilla 59, Spartak Saint Petersburg 78|url=http://basketball.realgm.com/international/boxscore/2013-01-16/Baloncesto-Sevilla-at-Spartak-Saint-Petersburg/119941|website=''[[RealGM]]''|accessdate=20 June 2015}} He scored his first basket for the senior team on February 20, 2013, in a rematch with Spartak. Porziņģis said, "I was very nervous at the beginning: I wanted to do well and not pick up turnovers. At the same time, I got a lot of confidence with players of my same age. That allowed me to play better with the first team and practice with more confidence." On May 4, 2013, he posted a season-high 7 points with the senior team, hitting two of three shots vs [[Bilbao Basket]] in [[Liga ACB|ACB]] competition.{{cite web|title=Bilbao Basket 81, Baloncesto Sevilla 60|url=http://basketball.realgm.com/international/boxscore/2013-05-04/Bilbao-Basket-at-Baloncesto-Sevilla/103817|website=''[[RealGM]]''|accessdate=22 June 2015}} [[File:AitoGarcíaUnicaja.JPG|thumb|right|[[Aíto García Reneses]] (pictured) coached Porziņģis in his first two seasons on Sevilla's senior team.]] Porziņģis opened his second season on Sevilla's main squad strong in his third game against the [[Euroleague]] team [[Saski Baskonia|Laboral Kutxa]], leading them to a 20-point ACB victory on November 2, 2013. He notched a career-high 12 points, 6 rebounds, and 4 blocks.{{cite web|title=2013-2014 International Games|url=http://basketball.realgm.com/player/Kristaps-Porzingis/GameLogs/32861/International/2014|website=''[[RealGM]]''|accessdate=22 June 2015}} He broke his scoring record once more against [[Real Madrid Baloncesto|Real Madrid]] on November 30, 2013, nearly leading his team to a victory. Against the very same team on April 6, 2014, Porziņģis scored a career-high 20 points, nailing 2 three-pointers. Despite his team losing, he began to trend on social media because of his performance. He said, "It was a very good game for me on offense. I didn't get any rebounds in that game. I had a good shooting night, but could have helped more on defense. Still, fans in Madrid gave me a nice ovation when I fouled out and I liked that a lot." On May 25, he got the chance to face his idol [[Justin Doellman]] of Barcelona, who he called the "best power forward in Spanish basketball." He scored 14 points on Doellman's team. On May 2014, Porziņģis was selected in the [[ACB Best Young Player Award|ACB All-Young Players Team]] of the [[2013–14 ACB season|2013–14 season]].{{cite web|url=http://www.acb.com/redaccion.php?id=103864|title=2013–14 ACB All-Young players Team|date=20 May 2014|publisher=ACB.com|language=Spanish|accessdate=June 2, 2014}} Prior to the [[2014–15 ACB season]], head coach Aíto García Reneses parted ways with the Sevilla.{{cite web|title=Coach Aito Reneses leaves Cajasol Sevilla|url=http://www.sportando.com/en/europe/spain/126153/coach-aito-reneses-leaves-cajasol-sevilla.html|website=''Sportando.com''|accessdate=22 June 2015}} On October 4, 2014, against [[CB 1939 Canarias]], Porziņģis made his season debut, scoring 3 points throughout the game. He made his first appearance at the [[2014–15 Eurocup Basketball|2014–15 Eurocup]] on October 15, vs. [[EWE Baskets Oldenburg]] and scored just 2 points. However, he had a strong Eurocup performance against [[Pallacanestro Virtus Roma]] in the weeks that followed, in which he contributed 18 points, 7 rebounds, 4 assists, 4 steals, and 2 blocks. He recorded a double-double in mid-November in a win over [[CB Estudiantes|Estudiantes]], adding 11 points and 11 rebounds. On February 11, 2015, he scored a season-high 19 points on the Eurocup's [[Turów Zgorzelec]]. He tied this record on April 18, 2015, vs. [[Bàsquet Manresa]] in the ACB.{{cite web|title=2014-2015 International Games|url=http://basketball.realgm.com/player/Kristaps-Porzingis/GameLogs/32861|website=''[[RealGM]]''|accessdate=22 June 2015}} On April 15, 2015, Porziņģis was named the winner of the [[Eurocup Basketball Awards#Eurocup Rising Star|Eurocup Rising Star]] Award of the season.{{cite web|url=http://www.eurocupbasketball.com/eurocup/news/i/5vvspvb5hnnlj9ye|title=2014-15 Eurocup Rising Star Trophy winner: Kristaps Porzingis, Baloncesto Seville|publisher=Eurocupbasketball.com|accessdate=April 14, 2015}} One month later, he repeated in the ACB All-Young Players Team, after avoiding the relegation with Baloncesto Sevilla.[http://www.acb.com/redaccion.php?id=113351 Mejor Quinteto Joven de la Liga Endesa 2014-15]; ACB.com, 19 May 2015 [[File:Pau Gasol by Augustas Didzgalvis (cropped).jpg|thumb|left|180px|[[Pau Gasol]] (pictured) was one of the many [[List of National Basketball Association players|NBA players]] Porziņģis was compared to prior to the 2015 draft.]] === NBA Draft === On April 28, 2014, Porziņģis declared himself eligible for the [[2014 NBA draft]].{{cite web|url=http://www.diena.lv/sports/basketbols/porzingis-tomer-pieteicies-nba-draftam-14053842|title=Porziņģis tomēr pieteicies NBA draftam|date=April 28, 2014|publisher=Diena.lv|language=Latvian|accessdate=April 29, 2014}} Before and after he made the decision, he drew interest from [[National Basketball Association]] (NBA) teams such as the [[Orlando Magic]], who held the 12th overall pick, traveled to Europe to scout him. The [[Oklahoma City Thunder]] reportedly were certainly going to select him with the 21st pick in the case that he remained. Porziņģis was considered an unfinished product and a top-15 draft pick. According to DraftExpress.com, he was the fourth-youngest prospect in their top-100 rankings.{{cite web|last1=Herbert|first1=James|title=NBA Draft 2014: Latvian prospect Kristaps Porzingis to enter draft|url=http://www.sbnation.com/nba/2014/4/28/5660788/kristaps-porzingis-nba-draft|website=''SB Nation''|accessdate=22 June 2015}} Shortly before the day of the draft, however, he withdrew his name. Porziņģis's [[sports agent|agent]] Andy Miller released the information to [[ESPN]], saying that his client did not feel prepared to become a part of the NBA and wanted to develop his skills until the [[2015 NBA draft|2015 draft]]. One of the league's general managers commented on him, "He's very talented. He wasn't ready, but we would've seriously considered drafting him anyway. If he continues to develop his game, get more minutes and his body develops, I think he could be a top-five pick in 2015. He has that kind of talent."{{cite web|last1=Ford|first1=Chad|title=Kristaps Porzingis pulls out of draft|url=http://espn.go.com/nba/draft2014/story/_/id/11090062/2014-nba-draft-kristaps-porzingis-latvia-pulls-draft|website=''[[ESPN]]''|accessdate=22 June 2015}} On April 16, 2015, Porziņģis entered the [[2015 NBA draft]], according to a report from agent Andy Miller.{{cite web|url=http://espn.go.com/nba/draft2015/story/_/id/12698126/latvian-power-forward-kristaps-porzingis-declare-nba-draft|title=Latvian power forward Kristaps Porzingis to enter draft|date=April 16, 2015|publisher=ESPN.com|accessdate=May 22, 2015}} After gaining a season more of experience, he became known as a [[NBA draft lottery|lottery]] pick and a potential top-5 selection. He drew interest from teams such as the [[Los Angeles Lakers]], who had the No. 2 pick and had several personnel that had seen Porziņģis play in Spain.{{cite web|last1=Ding|first1=Kevin|title=Mystery Man Kristaps Porzingis Tempts Many in NBA Draft, but Will Any Team Bite?|url=http://bleacherreport.com/articles/2503065-mystery-man-kristaps-porzingis-tempts-many-in-nba-draft-but-will-any-team-bite|website=[[Bleacher Report]]|accessdate=22 June 2015}} He was compared with players such as [[Pau Gasol]] and [[Dirk Nowitzki]], but also [[Darko Miličić]], a former lottery selection widely considered a [[draft bust]].{{cite web|last1=Murphy|first1=David|title=Why Kristaps Porzingis Could Be the Shocker of the 2015 NBA Draft Class|url=http://bleacherreport.com/articles/2500096-why-kristaps-porzingis-could-be-the-shocker-of-the-2015-nba-draft-class|website=[[Bleacher Report]]|accessdate=22 June 2015}} Adrian Wojnarowski of [[Yahoo! Sports]] wrote, "Porziņģis has an innate awareness about the way the American public sees a young, long European teenager. He comes to the NBA with the full understanding that popular basketball culture declares him guilty until proven innocent of the basketball crimes of Darko Miličić and [[Nikoloz Tskitishvili]] and [[Andrea Bargnani]]. He's considered a stiff, a bust, a blown lottery pick until he doesn't become one..."{{cite web|last1=Wojnarowski|first1=Adrian|title=Meet the Euro prodigy who seems unlike the flops who came before him|url=http://sports.yahoo.com/news/meet-the-euro-prodigy-who-seems-unlike-the-flops-who-came-before-him-193427860.html|website=[[Yahoo! Sports]]|accessdate=22 June 2015}} ==International career== Porziņģis played with the [[Latvia national basketball team|Latvian youth team]] and was selected in the [[2013 FIBA Europe Under-18 Championship]] All-Team. == Player profile == Porziņģis has been strongly compared to [[Pau Gasol]], but has been even more praised than the [[National Basketball Association|NBA]] player in terms of athleticism. A general manager in the NBA commented on Porziņģis's [[2015 NBA draft|2015 NBA draft prospect]], saying, "I've been asking my team since then: Are you sure he's not the No. 1 guy? Are these guys in college really better than him?"{{cite web|title=2015 Draft Prospect Kristaps Porzingis|url=http://www.nba.com/nuggets/draft/2015/prospect/Kristaps-Porzingis|website=''NBA.com''|accessdate=20 June 2015}} == Personal == Porziņģis was born on August 2, 1995 in [[Liepāja]], [[Latvia]] to parents that had experienced playing the game of [[basketball]]. Tālis, his father, competed semi-professionally before becoming a [[bus driver]]. His mother, Ingrīda, was previously on [[Latvia women's national basketball team|Latvia women's youth national basketball team]]. Kristaps's older brother [[Jānis Porziņģis|Jānis]], who is about thirteen years older than him, also played, while Mārtiņš, who is approximately fifteen years older than his youngest sibling, was also an an avid player.{{cite web|last1=Weitzman|first1=Yaron|title=NBA Draft Watch: The Kristaps Porzingis Experience|url=http://www.aol.com/article/2015/06/22/nba-draft-watch-the-kristaps-porzingis-experience/21199493/|website=[[AOL]]|accessdate=23 June 2015}} Jānis Porziņģis competed at the Eurocup level before Kristaps and had played European basketball for more than 10 years. He is known to mentor his younger brother on and off the court and often called him after playing games for Cajasol Sevilla in Spain. Kristaps talked about the relationship in an interview, "We'd break down the details. We watched the film together. He’s always pushing me to work hard. We just spend a lot of time together and we just talk about basketball all the time..."{{cite web|last1=Robbins|first1=Josh|title=A Q-and-A with NBA Draft prospect Kristaps Porzingis|url=http://www.orlandosentinel.com/sports/orlando-magic/os-kristaps-porzingis-interview-20150622-story.html#page=1|website=[[Orlando Sentinel]]|accessdate=22 June 2015}} The elder Porziņģis helped him train in the summer and work out in the gym in preparation for international competition in 2012. Following two seasons in Spain and almost two years living in Seville, Porziņģis supposedly spoke Spanish far more fluently. He knew little of the language before joining Cajasol Sevilla, but knew how to speak English since his childhood. At 19 years old, Porziņģis is fluent in three different languages. An executive said, "He speaks great English and I don't see it being that difficult of a transition off the court."{{cite web|title=Scotto: Kristaps Porzingis Transcends the European Stereotype|url=http://www.sheridanhoops.com/2015/06/19/scotto-kristaps-porzingis-transcends-the-european-stereotype/|website=''SheridanHoops.com''|accessdate=22 June 2015}} ==References== {{Reflist|2}} ==External links== * [http://www.acb.com/jugador.php?id=259 Kristaps Porziņģis] at ACB.com * [http://www.draftexpress.com/profile/Kristaps-Porzingis-7119/ Kristaps Porziņģis] at draftexpress.com * [http://basketball.eurobasket.com/player/Kristaps_Porzingis/214256 Kristaps Porziņģis] at eurobasket.com * [http://www.euroleague.net/competition/players/showplayer?pcode=003695 Kristaps Porziņģis] at euroleague.net * {{twitter|kporzee}} {{Eurocup Rising Star}} {{Persondata | NAME = Porzingis, Kristaps | ALTERNATIVE NAMES = | SHORT DESCRIPTION = Basketball player | DATE OF BIRTH = 2 August 1995 | PLACE OF BIRTH = [[Liepāja]], [[Latvia]] | DATE OF DEATH = | PLACE OF DEATH = }} {{DEFAULTSORT:Porzingis, Kristaps}} [[Category:1995 births]] [[Category:Living people]] [[Category:CB Sevilla players]] [[Category:Latvian basketball players]] [[Category:Liga ACB players]] [[Category:Sportspeople from Liepāja]]
